title: The Founding Hearth in Dhampur
titleHindi: धामपुर में नींव और पारंपरिक मिष्ठान
description: Founded by [FOUNDER NAME - e.g. Shri Gudduramji Halwai], beginning as a beloved sweetmaker revered across Dhampur and Bijnor district for pure desi ghee preparation, uncompromising integrity, and divine taste.

title: Expansion into Grand Community Feasts
description: On immense public demand, the kitchen expanded from sweet making into full-course wedding dinners and large spiritual gatherings, setting new benchmarks for regional hospitality.

title: Inception of G.D. Caterers Modern Fleet
description: Formalized under the banner of G.D. Caterers — a proud unit of Gudduramji Halwai — introducing five-star live counters, imported chafing vessels, and multi-regional culinary master chefs.

title: The Regal Wedding Benchmark of Western UP
titleHindi: शाही शादियों का सबसे विश्वसनीय नाम
description: Today catering India's grandest destination and palace weddings across Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and Delhi NCR, orchestrating feasts for up to 15,000 guests in a single evening.
